item.anime_multiverse.magnas_soul_bat.lo: A flame-studded club. Magna Swing casts through it: the spell is a ball tossed ahead, the swing sends it.
item.anime_multiverse.magnas_soul_bat.us: Hold it in the main hand to cast the Fire pages of Magna's grimoire.
anime_multiverse.firecast.spent: The spiral stops winding: no mana left.
anime_multiverse.firecast.ready: Ready: the page. Punch to release it.
anime_multiverse.firecast.spirit.full: The Salamander cannot answer: too many spirits are out.
anime_multiverse.firecast.spirit.unlinke: The Salamander returns to its flames.
